description: Na₆Mg₂C₄SO₁₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fd̅3m space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.74 Å. Mg is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.03 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.28 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All S-O bond lengths are 1.49 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one S atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃S trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Mg, and one C atom.
